answer: One concrete defense is stake-locked identity with slashing: each agent bonds tokens before transacting, and peers attest its behavior across many epochs. A sybil swarm must lock capital for every fake identity, so nectar flows only to agents whose bond is old and vouched for; like a river carving channels around a cedar's roots, rewards follow long-standing stake. When attestors detect collusion, the slash burns each fake bond, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand deposits.
